description: Canonical cosmetic catalog for Star Sanctuary. This JSON is the shared source of truth consumed by (a) the V2.x shop seed loader (lib/db.ts), (b) the V2 cosmic-palette sprite generator (public/sanctuary/cosmetics/), and (c) the V3 Forgotten-Memories-palette sprite generator (public/sanctuary-v3/cosmetics/). The shop schema currently supports the 'hat' | 'accessory' | 'background' | 'animation' categories and 'common' | 'uncommon' | 'rare' | 'legendary' rarities; the 'floor' and 'seasonal' categories and the 'epic' rarity used here require the V2.3 schema migration tracked separately as SWO_V2_3_SHOP_CATEGORY_EXPANSION.

sprite_dimensions.animation: particle/effect overlay, 64x64 sheet of 4 frames at 16x16
sprite_dimensions.seasonal: varies by sub-type, see per-item pixel_art_spec.dimensions

items.name: Acorn Cap
items.description: A tiny acorn cap, perfect for forest strolls.

pixel_art_spec.motif: rounded acorn cap with a single stem nub on top
pixel_art_spec.notes: Silhouette must read at 1:1; no anti-aliasing.

items.name: Star Beanie
items.description: A cozy beanie embroidered with a single bright star.

pixel_art_spec.motif: snug beanie with a 3x3 four-point star embroidered on the front cuff
pixel_art_spec.notes: Cuff is 1px lighter than body to suggest folded knit.

items.name: Witch Hat
items.description: A pointed hat that hums faintly with arcane energy.

pixel_art_spec.motif: tall conical hat with curled tip; wide brim flares 2px past the head
pixel_art_spec.notes: Tip droops 1px to feel jaunty; faint 1px shimmer dot near tip in V2 only.

items.name: Party Horn
items.description: A festive striped party hat with a tiny pom-pom.

pixel_art_spec.motif: cone with three diagonal stripes; 3x3 pom-pom on the apex
pixel_art_spec.notes: Tilt rendered into the sprite (not via runtime rotation) to keep edges crisp.

items.name: Explorer's Visor
items.description: A weathered visor stitched from old star-charts.

pixel_art_spec.motif: low-slung visor with side strap; 1px buckle on right
pixel_art_spec.notes: No top, sits low so eyes still read at 32px display.

items.name: Gold Crown
items.description: Worn by the rulers of forgotten constellations.

pixel_art_spec.motif: three-spike crown band, center spike taller, single gem in front
pixel_art_spec.notes: Gem uses a single 2x2 cluster with one highlight pixel.

items.name: Cosmic Halo
items.description: A floating ring of starlight that orbits the wearer.

pixel_art_spec.anchor: floats 2px above the companion head, no contact
pixel_art_spec.motif: thin elliptical ring; 1px glow halo; 4 sparkle pixels evenly spaced on the ring
pixel_art_spec.notes: Should pair with anim_star_sparkle if both equipped — ring stays stationary, sparkles orbit.

items.name: Nebula Crown
items.description: A crown spun from raw nebula dust. Only the boldest dare wear it.

pixel_art_spec.motif: wide crown with five rising tendrils of nebula dust; three jewel pixels along the band
pixel_art_spec.notes: Tendrils animate via anim layer if available; static base is 14 tall.

items.name: Star Pendant
items.description: A simple pendant carved from meteorite glass.

pixel_art_spec.motif: 1px cord forming a U-shape with a 4x4 four-point star at the bottom
pixel_art_spec.notes: Star is the focal point; cord is single-pixel only.

items.name: Comet Scarf
items.description: A long scarf with a flowing comet-tail pattern.

pixel_art_spec.anchor: wraps around neck, two trailing ends drift right
pixel_art_spec.motif: scarf with two trailing tails of decreasing width; 3 scattered sparkle pixels along the tails
pixel_art_spec.notes: Tail tips taper to 1px to suggest motion.

items.name: Moon Glasses
items.description: Tinted spectacles that filter even the brightest sun.

pixel_art_spec.motif: two round lenses connected by a 2px bridge; one 1px glint on the upper-right of each lens
pixel_art_spec.notes: Render order: above eye layer; do not draw lens fill where it would clip outside head silhouette.

items.name: Aura Ribbon
items.description: A ribbon woven from threads of pure aura.

pixel_art_spec.anchor: tied at companion crown, bow falls to the right
pixel_art_spec.motif: small bow on top with two streamers; faint 1px wisp pixels float beside the streamers
pixel_art_spec.notes: Aura wisp pixels appear only in V2; V3 omits the wisp.

items.name: Nebula Collar
items.description: A collar that shimmers with swirling cosmic gases.

pixel_art_spec.motif: thick collar with two interleaved diagonal swirls and a single front stud
pixel_art_spec.notes: Swirls are 1px wide; alternate the two swirl colors every other pixel for shimmer feel.

items.name: Eclipse Pendant
items.description: Forged during a total eclipse. Pulses with shadow-light.

pixel_art_spec.motif: 1px cord with a 6x6 black disc surrounded by a 1px golden corona; one 1px flare offset top-left
pixel_art_spec.notes: Corona is full ring (no gaps) so it reads as eclipse, not a hole.

items.name: Starfield
items.description: A peaceful field of distant pinprick stars.

pixel_art_spec.motif: scattered 1px stars at low density (~50 per 320x180); 5-pixel cluster every ~80px for variety
pixel_art_spec.notes: No nebula clouds — keep it minimal so it pairs with any companion.

items.name: Soft Aurora
items.description: Pale curtains of green and pink light drifting overhead.

pixel_art_spec.motif: two vertical wavy curtains (one green, one pink) that drift left-right; 30 background stars
pixel_art_spec.notes: Curtains use 8 alpha-stepped vertical bands rendered with palette dithering, no true alpha.

items.name: Cosmic Dawn
items.description: The first warm light of a galactic morning.

pixel_art_spec.motif: horizontal bands fading from indigo top to amber bottom; small 8x8 sun disc on the right horizon
pixel_art_spec.notes: Bands are 12px tall each; dithering for transitions, no true gradients.

items.name: Nebula Drift
items.description: Slow-rolling clouds of cyan and violet stardust.

pixel_art_spec.motif: three overlapping cloud blobs (two cyan, one violet) with dithered edges; 60 background stars
pixel_art_spec.notes: Edges dithered 1px; no hard cloud silhouettes.

items.name: Galaxy Swirl
items.description: A full spiral galaxy spinning lazily behind your companion.

pixel_art_spec.motif: two-arm logarithmic spiral, ~120px diameter, centered; 80 background stars
pixel_art_spec.notes: Arms are 2px wide tapering to 1px; core is a 6px disc with 8px glow halo.

items.name: Grass Tile
items.description: Soft starlit grass underfoot.

pixel_art_spec.motif: scattered 2-3px grass tufts with subtle 1px shadow underneath each tuft
pixel_art_spec.notes: Edges must seam without visible repetition; verify by tiling 4x4 in preview.

items.name: Starwood Planks
items.description: Polished planks cut from a fallen star tree.

pixel_art_spec.motif: three horizontal planks (10/12/10 px) with 1px dark seams; 1-2 gold flecks per tile to suggest starwood
pixel_art_spec.notes: Vary plank widths so 4x4 tiles do not look perfectly grid-aligned.

items.name: Crystal Marble
items.description: Cool marble veined with luminous crystal threads.

pixel_art_spec.motif: polished slab with 2-3 thin veins meandering corner-to-corner; one bright pixel per vein
pixel_art_spec.notes: Veins must continue when tiled — design them to enter and exit at consistent edge positions.

items.name: Nebula Glass
items.description: Translucent panels poured from cooled nebula vapor.

pixel_art_spec.motif: deep panel with two interleaving swirls and 4-5 1px sparkle pixels
pixel_art_spec.notes: Sparkle positions stay fixed (no animation in floor layer).

items.name: Constellation Mosaic
items.description: A floor mosaic depicting a complete constellation map.

pixel_art_spec.anchor: tileable both axes (larger tile to preserve mosaic motif)
pixel_art_spec.motif: 10 star nodes connected by 1px lines forming two recognizable constellation shapes per tile
pixel_art_spec.notes: This is the only 64x64 floor — engine must accept either 32 or 64 px tile sizes for floors.

items.name: Gentle Bob
items.description: A soft up-and-down bob, like floating on calm water.

pixel_art_spec.motif: shift companion sprite +1/-1px on Y over a 60-frame loop (30 up, 30 down)
pixel_art_spec.notes: Implementation is a transform tween, not a sprite. Spec retained here for catalog completeness.

items.name: Star Sparkle
items.description: Tiny sparkles burst around the companion at random.

pixel_art_spec.anchor: spawned at random offset within 24x24 box around companion center
pixel_art_spec.motif: 4-frame sparkle: 1px → 4-point star → 6-point star → fade
pixel_art_spec.notes: Particle lifetime ~30 frames; spawn rate 1 per second.

items.name: Aurora Dance
items.description: Aurora ribbons twirl rhythmically around the companion.

pixel_art_spec.anchor: wraps around companion at chest height
pixel_art_spec.motif: two ribbon strands (teal + rose) that swap depth across 4 frames, rotating around companion
pixel_art_spec.notes: Loop length 90 frames; alpha simulated via dither, not true alpha.

items.name: Constellation Burst
items.description: Periodic bursts of constellation glyphs orbit the companion.

pixel_art_spec.motif: each frame shows a different 5-star constellation glyph fading in then orbiting
pixel_art_spec.notes: Burst once every 8 seconds; do not overlap with other equipped animations.

items.name: Spring Petals
items.description: Drifting cherry-blossom petals — available only during the Spring window.

pixel_art_spec.dimensions: 64x64 sprite sheet (4 frames at 16x16) plus full-room overlay 320x180
pixel_art_spec.anchor: petal particles drift from top of room toward bottom-right
pixel_art_spec.motif: 4-frame swaying 3x3 petal; spawned at low density across the backdrop
pixel_art_spec.notes: Availability gated by SEASONAL_WINDOWS.spring (March 20 – April 30) — see SWO_V2_3_SHOP_CATEGORY_EXPANSION.

items.name: Winter Snow
items.description: Soft starlit snowfall — available only during the Winter window.

pixel_art_spec.dimensions: 64x64 sprite sheet (4 frames at 16x16) plus full-room overlay 320x180
pixel_art_spec.anchor: snowflake particles drift from top of room straight down with slight sway
pixel_art_spec.motif: 4-frame 3x3 snowflake (rotation by quarter-turn each frame); ground accumulation row at the very bottom of overlay
pixel_art_spec.notes: Availability gated by SEASONAL_WINDOWS.winter (December 1 – February 14).
